story.title: Progression into a saved shot
story.summary: Aster’s pass to Rowan advanced the ball, but the gap at the fixed receiving point narrowed by reception. Rowan then found Noor, whose movement offered a destination ahead of the pass. At Noor’s receiving point, the gap to the nearest opponent was wider by reception. The sequence ended with the goalkeeper saving the shot.
